
### better encodings {.smaller}
* need to keep sender/receiver in sync
   * may enforce having frequent transitions to resync
   * (avoid long strings of all-low/all-high)
* transmit more than just 0/1 at each time:
    * use more levels than just low/high
    * vary more than just one thing 
       * example: pulse amplitude and duration
    * may allow for "control" symbols
* probably covered in ECE Signals course?
